column2: agreed merge:córnea, but córneo is a real adjective (capa córnea, tejido córneo) distinct from the eye noun córnea
agreed merge:esponja, but esponjar is a real verb (to fluff up); a merge into the noun may hide it
agreed merge:amar, but amarar is a real verb (to land on water); check the forms
agreed merge:simultáneo, but simultanear is a real verb (to do at the same time)
agreed merge:híbrido, but hibridar is a real verb (to hybridise)
agreed merge:troza, but trozar is a real verb (to cut into pieces or logs)
agreed merge:decremento, but decrementar is a real verb in use (opposite of incrementar)
agreed merge:córnea, but cornear is a real verb (to gore, of a bull); the target looks wrong
agreed merge:aducir; adujar is also a real nautical verb (to coil rope), though adujo is a form of aducir; check which reading the forms show
agreed merge:ripio, but ripiar is a real (Caribbean) verb (to shred)
agreed merge:chinche, but chinchar is a common colloquial verb (to annoy: no me chinches)
agreed merge:jabón, but jabonar is a real verb (to soap)
agreed merge:rutilo, but rutilar is a real verb (to shine); rutilo is a mineral
agreed merge:esclerótica, but esclerótico is a real adjective (sclerotic), distinct from the eye noun
agreed merge:preciso, but precisa is also the 3sg of precisar (to need/specify); check whether the verb reading is the majority
agreed merge:prueba, but pruebo is the 1sg of probar; the target looks wrong (merge:probar?)
agreed merge:tesorería; a cut-off tesorer could equally be tesorero (or tesorera); check the forms
agreed merge:contenido, but contenidor looks like a misspelling of contenedor (or Catalan for container); check the target
agreed merge:valorar; the lemmatiser convention keeps pronominal verbs as their own lemma (hacerse, quedarse)
agreed merge:hacer, but hacero may be a misspelling of acero (steel); check the forms
agreed merge:fregona, but fregón is a real adjective (Mexican colloquial: skilled, or annoying)
agreed merge:holográfico, but ológrafo/ológrafa is a distinct real word (testamento ológrafo); check the target
agreed accent merge:círculo, but circulo is also the 1sg of circular; check whether the verb reading matters
agreed drop, but rever is a real Spanish verb (to see again, to review)
agreed drop, but changar is a real Latin American verb (to do odd jobs)
agreed drop, but noticiar is a real (if rare) Spanish verb (to give news of)
agreed drop, but ponible is a Spanish adjective in real use (tecnología ponible, wearable)
agreed merge:brea, but brear is a real verb (to tar; to pester)
agreed merge:despecho, but despechar is a real verb (to spite; to wean)
